1.

The present petition is filed seeking quashing of Fir No. 74/2022 dated 18.01.2022, registered at
Police Station Sangam Vihar, for offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860, including all consequential proceedings arising therefrom, on the ground of settlement.

2.  The learned counsel for the parties submit that, in terms of the settlement, a sum of 1,00,000/-
is handed over to the complainant and the balance amount of 1,00,000/- will be paid tomorrow when another connected matter is listed.
3.
They request that the present matter be taken up tomorrow.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 14/08/2024 at 06:15:16 4.
